id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-information
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: Please review the *information* carefully before signing.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-decision
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: The manager made a final *decision* yesterday.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-development
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: The *development* of the new product took two years.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-awareness
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: The campaign raised public *awareness* of recycling.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-responsibility
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: It is her *responsibility* to check the figures.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-performance
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: His *performance* has improved significantly.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-employee
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: Every *employee* must attend the training session.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-applicant
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: The *applicant* submitted her resume online.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-each-other
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: The two teams cooperated with *each other*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-one-another
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: The staff members helped *one another* during the busy season.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-on-one's-own
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: She finished the project *on her own*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-another
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: Could you show me *another* option?

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞#v-the-others
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/01_名詞與代名詞
example: Two boxes are here; *the others* are still in transit.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-discuss
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The team will *discuss* the proposal tomorrow.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-address
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The manager will *address* the customer's concerns.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-submit
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: Employees must *submit* the form by Friday.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-announce
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The company will *announce* the merger next week.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-arrive
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
meaning: 到達（後接 at/in，不可直接加受詞）
example: The shipment will *arrive* at the warehouse tomorrow.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-occur
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The error *occurred* during the system update.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-consist-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The committee *consists of* five members.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-result-in-/-result-from
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The delay *resulted from* a technical issue.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-appear
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The results *appear* promising.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-remain
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The office *remains* closed on holidays.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-turn
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
example: The weather *turned* cold suddenly.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-rise-/-raise
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
meaning: 上升(不及物) / 提高(及物)
example: Prices *rise* every year. / The firm *raised* its prices.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類#v-lie-/-lay
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/02_動詞分類
meaning: 躺、位於(不及物) / 放置(及物)
example: The documents *lie* on the desk. / She *laid* the documents on the desk.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-considerable
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: The project required a *considerable* amount of time.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-reliable
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: We need a *reliable* supplier for this material.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-comprehensive
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: The manual provides a *comprehensive* guide to the software.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-noticeable
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: There has been a *noticeable* increase in sales.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-considerate
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
meaning: 體貼的（易與 considerable 混淆）
example: He is always *considerate* toward his colleagues.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-approximately
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: The meeting will last *approximately* two hours.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-significantly
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: Revenue increased *significantly* this quarter.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-accordingly
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: Please review the schedule and plan *accordingly*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-currently
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: The position is *currently* unavailable.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-relatively
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: The cost is *relatively* low compared to competitors.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-economic-/-economical
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: *economic* growth / an *economical* car

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞#v-respective-/-respectively
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/03_形容詞與副詞
example: They returned to their *respective* offices. / They arrived at 9 and 10, *respectively*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-although-/-even-though
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: *Although* the budget was limited, the team completed the project.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-because-/-since-/-as
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: *Since* the client was unavailable, the meeting was postponed.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-while
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: *While* sales grew in Asia, they declined in Europe.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-unless
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: *Unless* you register early, you may not get a seat.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-once
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: *Once* the contract is signed, the project can begin.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-despite-/-in-spite-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: *Despite* the rain, the event proceeded as planned.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-because-of-/-due-to-/-owing-to
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
word: because of / due to / owing to
example: The flight was delayed *due to* bad weather.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-not-only...but-also
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: The plan is *not only* cost-effective *but also* efficient.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-either...or
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: You can *either* call us *or* send an email.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞#v-as-a-result
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/04_連接詞
example: Sales dropped; *as a result*, the company cut costs.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-during
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: Sales increased *during* the holiday season.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-since
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: The company has grown rapidly *since* 2015.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-by
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: Please submit the report *by* Friday.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-within
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: The refund will be processed *within* 7 business days.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-due-to
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: The delay was *due to* a technical error.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-in-accordance-with
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: The refund is issued *in accordance with* company policy.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-regarding-/-concerning
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: Please contact us *regarding* your account.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-be-responsible-for
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: She *is responsible for* managing the budget.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-be-familiar-with
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: New staff should *be familiar with* the safety guidelines.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-in-charge-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: He *is in charge of* the marketing department.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-on-behalf-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: She signed the contract *on behalf of* the company.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞#v-as-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/05_介系詞
example: *As of* next month, the office will relocate.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-offer
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: The company *offered* her a promotion.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-send
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: Please *send* the client a confirmation email.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-show
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: He *showed* the manager his portfolio.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-grant
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: The university *granted* him a scholarship.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-consider
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: We *consider* the plan feasible.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-appoint
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: The board *appointed* her CEO.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-keep
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: Please *keep* the door open.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-name
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: They *named* him team leader.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-remain
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: The market *remains* stable.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-become
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: The company *became* profitable within a year.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-there-be
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: *There are* several options available.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型#v-it-is...that
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/06_五大句型
example: *It was* the manager *that* approved the budget.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-a-variety-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: The store offers *a variety of* products.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-the-majority-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: *The majority of* employees support the new policy.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-on-a-regular-basis
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: The team meets *on a regular basis*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-numerous
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
meaning: 許多的（後接複數可數名詞）
example: The firm has received *numerous* awards.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-a-couple-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: It will take *a couple of* days to process.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-plenty-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
meaning: 大量的（可數/不可數皆可）
example: There is *plenty of* time to finish the task.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-a-handful-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: Only *a handful of* candidates passed the exam.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-the-entire-/-the-whole
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: *The entire* team worked overtime.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-each
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: *Each* department has its own budget.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-every-other
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: The newsletter is sent out *every other* week.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞#v-either-/-neither
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/07_冠詞與數量詞
example: *Neither* option seems suitable.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-abundant
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The company enjoys an *abundant* supply of raw materials from its regional suppliers.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-ample
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The new warehouse provides *ample* storage space for the upcoming holiday inventory.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-an-array-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The vendor showcased *an array of* products at the trade show booth.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-a-fraction-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Only *a fraction of* the budget has been spent so far this quarter.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-the-bulk-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: *The bulk of* the shipment will arrive by sea freight next week.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-countless
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The project manager fielded *countless* questions from anxious stakeholders.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-dozens-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: *Dozens of* applicants responded to the job posting within a single day.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-minority
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Only a *minority* of shareholders opposed the proposed acquisition.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-scarce
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Skilled technicians have become increasingly *scarce* in the local labor market.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-sizable
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The startup secured a *sizable* investment from a venture capital firm.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-digit
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Please enter the six-*digit* confirmation code sent to your email.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-double
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The firm's profits *doubled* after the merger was finalized.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-figure
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The sales *figure* for October exceeded all previous quarterly records.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-fraction
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Only a small *fraction* of employees opted out of the new insurance plan.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-gross
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The company's *gross* revenue reached ten million dollars last fiscal year.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-innumerable
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The audit uncovered *innumerable* discrepancies in the expense reports.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-multiple
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The candidate had received *multiple* job offers before accepting this position.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-net
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: After taxes and expenses, the *net* profit was lower than projected.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-numeral
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The invoice number must be written using Arabic *numerals* only.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-overall
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The *overall* customer satisfaction rating improved this quarter.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-per-capita
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The report compared *per capita* spending across different regional offices.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-percentile
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Applicants scoring above the ninetieth *percentile* were invited for an interview.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-proportion
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The *proportion* of remote workers has grown steadily since last year.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-quantity
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The supplier offers discounts for orders placed in large *quantity*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-quota
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Each sales representative must meet a monthly *quota* to qualify for the bonus.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-ratio
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The manager tracks the *ratio* of complaints to total orders each week.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-statistic
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The latest *statistic* shows a decline in average delivery times.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-tally
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The clerk had to *tally* the inventory items by hand after the system crashed.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-threefold
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: Demand for the product increased *threefold* after the advertising campaign launched.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法#v-twofold
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/08_數量詞與數詞用法
example: The benefits of the new system are *twofold*: faster processing and fewer errors.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-however
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The proposal was well received; *however*, the budget committee rejected it.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-nevertheless
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The report contained several errors; *nevertheless*, management approved it.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-nonetheless
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Profits declined this quarter; *nonetheless*, the board approved a dividend payout.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-in-contrast
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Overseas sales rose sharply; *in contrast*, domestic sales remained flat.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-on-the-other-hand
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Hiring more staff would speed up production; *on the other hand*, it would raise labor costs.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-conversely
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The east warehouse is fully stocked; *conversely*, the west warehouse is running low on supplies.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-moreover
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The candidate has strong references; *moreover*, she has five years of relevant experience.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-furthermore
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The new system reduces errors; *furthermore*, it cuts processing time in half.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-in-addition
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The firm expanded its product line; *in addition*, it opened two new retail outlets.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-additionally
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The contractor finished ahead of schedule; *additionally*, the project came in under budget.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-besides
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The vendor offers competitive prices; *besides*, its delivery record is excellent.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-therefore
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The client missed the payment deadline; *therefore*, the account was suspended.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-thus
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Demand exceeded supply; *thus*, the company raised its prices.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-hence
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The merger was finalized last month; *hence*, the two teams now report to one director.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-consequently
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The server crashed twice this week; *consequently*, the IT department is upgrading the hardware.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-as-such
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The position requires travel; *as such*, applicants must hold a valid passport.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-for-instance
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Several policies were revised; *for instance*, employees may now work remotely twice a week.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-for-example
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The firm has cut several expenses; *for example*, it switched to a cheaper courier service.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-namely
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Two departments missed their targets, *namely* marketing and logistics.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-in-other-words
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The client wants a full refund; *in other words*, the contract will be terminated.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-that-is-to-say
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The plant will run at half capacity; *that is to say*, only one shift will operate.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-similarly
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The Taipei office adopted flexible hours; *similarly*, the Tainan branch introduced the same policy.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-likewise
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The finance team streamlined its approval process; *likewise*, HR simplified its onboarding forms.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-meanwhile
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The auditors reviewed the accounts; *meanwhile*, the staff prepared for the site inspection.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-in-the-meantime
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The replacement part will arrive next week; *in the meantime*, technicians will use a temporary fix.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-afterward
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The board reviewed the proposal; *afterward*, they scheduled a vote for the following meeting.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-in-fact
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The project was not merely completed on time; *in fact*, it finished two weeks early.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-indeed
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Customer complaints did not increase; *indeed*, satisfaction scores improved.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-instead
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: The supplier could not meet the order; the buyer, *instead*, contacted a backup vendor.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞#v-alternatively
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/09_轉承連接副詞
example: Staff may attend the workshop in person; *alternatively*, they can join via video conference.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-embarrassing
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Forgetting the client's name was an *embarrassing* moment for the new sales rep.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-embarrassed
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The presenter felt *embarrassed* after the projector failed twice.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-disappointing
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The quarterly figures were rather *disappointing* compared to last year.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-disappointed
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Several investors were *disappointed* by the delayed product launch.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-annoying
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The constant printer malfunctions have become *annoying* for the whole office.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-annoyed
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Clients grew *annoyed* after being placed on hold for over twenty minutes.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-rewarding
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Mentoring junior staff has proven to be a *rewarding* part of her role.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-challenging
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Coordinating three overseas offices at once is a *challenging* task.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-puzzling
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The sudden drop in website traffic remains a *puzzling* issue for the marketing team.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-well-known
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The firm partnered with a *well-known* accounting agency for the audit.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-well-established
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
meaning: 制度完善的、久負盛名的
example: The company follows a *well-established* procedure for handling refunds.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-well-informed
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: A *well-informed* customer is less likely to file a complaint.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-well-received
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The new packaging design was *well-received* at the trade fair.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-well-suited
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Her background in logistics makes her *well-suited* for the operations role.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-customer-oriented
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The chain trains every clerk to take a *customer-oriented* approach.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-results-driven
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The department adopted a *results-driven* strategy this quarter.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-time-consuming
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Manually reconciling the accounts is a *time-consuming* process.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-cost-effective
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Outsourcing the printing job turned out to be more *cost-effective*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-user-friendly
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The updated app interface is far more *user-friendly*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-labor-intensive
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Sorting the packages by hand remains a *labor-intensive* task.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-long-term
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The board approved a *long-term* expansion plan for the region.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-short-term
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The firm hired temporary staff to cover the *short-term* workload increase.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-full-time
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: She was offered a *full-time* position after her internship ended.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-part-time
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Several *part-time* clerks were promoted after the seasonal rush.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-self-employed
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Many freelance consultants are *self-employed*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-self-motivated
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
meaning: 自我激勵的、主動積極的
example: The recruiter looks for candidates who are *self-motivated*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-up-to-date
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: Keep the client database *up-to-date* at all times.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-state-of-the-art
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The factory recently installed a *state-of-the-art* packaging line.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-in-house
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The legal team now handles most contracts *in-house* instead of outsourcing them.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞#v-far-reaching
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/10_分詞形容詞與複合形容詞
example: The merger is expected to have *far-reaching* effects on both companies.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-apposition
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The two nouns stand in *apposition* to each other in the sentence.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-appositive
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: "The manager, a former accountant," contains an *appositive*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-parenthetical
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The *parenthetical* remark did not change the sentence's main meaning.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-insert
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: Please *insert* the clarification between the two commas.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-elaborate
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The manager *elaborated* on the new refund policy during the meeting.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-clarify
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The memo was revised to *clarify* the reporting deadline.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-specify
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The contract failed to *specify* which party bears the shipping cost.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-restate
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The consultant *restated* the proposal in simpler terms for the board.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-rephrase
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: She *rephrased* the instructions so new hires could follow them easily.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-incidentally
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: *Incidentally*, the supplier also raised its shipping rates this quarter.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-notably
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: Two departments, *notably* sales and marketing, missed their targets.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-particularly
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The client was *particularly* concerned about the delivery schedule.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-specifically
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The audit *specifically* targeted overseas transactions.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-formerly
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: Mr. Kato, *formerly* the finance director, now advises the board.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-renowned
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: A *renowned* consultant was hired to redesign the workflow.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-prominent
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: A *prominent* investor joined the company's advisory board.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-distinguished
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The keynote speaker is a *distinguished* professor of economics.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-veteran
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: Mr. Lin, a *veteran* of the logistics industry, oversees the new hub.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-aforementioned
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: The *aforementioned* clause applies to all overseas branches.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構#v-colleague
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/11_同位語與插入語結構
example: Her *colleague*, the head of procurement, co-signed the request.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-inquire
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The client called to *inquire* when the replacement parts would be shipped.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-wonder
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The intern was *wondering* how the reimbursement process worked.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-determine
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The committee has yet to *determine* which candidate best fits the role.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-confirm
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: We need to *confirm* whether the venue is available on that date.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-query
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The auditor raised a *query* about who approved the transaction.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-uncertain
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: Management remains *uncertain* how the new tariff will affect pricing.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-unclear
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: It is still *unclear* why the shipment was held at customs.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-undecided
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The board is *undecided* on when the merger should be announced.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-rationale
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The email explained the *rationale* behind why the office would close early.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-whereabouts
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: Security could not confirm the *whereabouts* of the missing package.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-discretion
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: It is left to the manager's *discretion* who attends the client dinner.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-outline
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The handbook *outlines* what employees should do in an emergency.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-assess
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The team is trying to *assess* how much the delay will cost the project.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句#v-prompt
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/12_疑問詞與間接問句
example: The complaint *prompted* an investigation into why the refund was delayed.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-machinery
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The factory replaced all its outdated *machinery* last quarter.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-merchandise
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The warehouse stores seasonal *merchandise* before it reaches retail stores.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-luggage
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: Passengers are asked to label their *luggage* before boarding.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-baggage
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
meaning: 行李（不可數，與 luggage 同義）
example: The airline charges extra for overweight *baggage*.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-stationery
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The office manager ordered new *stationery* for the entire floor.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-jewelry
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The store displays its finest *jewelry* in a locked case.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-currency
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
meaning: 貨幣（不可數，指某國通貨）
example: The invoice must specify the *currency* used for payment.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-cutlery
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The restaurant ordered new *cutlery* for its renovated dining hall.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-clothing
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The factory produces protective *clothing* for warehouse workers.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-cash
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: Customers may pay in *cash* or by credit card.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-traffic
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: Heavy *traffic* delayed the delivery truck by two hours.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-artwork
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The gallery insured all the *artwork* before the exhibition opened.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-homework
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The training manual assigns *homework* for new hires to complete at home.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-correspondence
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: All official *correspondence* must be archived for at least five years.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-feedback
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The manager reviewed the customer *feedback* before revising the policy.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-garbage
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The cleaning crew removes *garbage* from the office every evening.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-freight
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The company ships its *freight* by rail to reduce costs.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-cargo
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
meaning: 貨物（不可數，多指船運/空運）
example: The vessel carried industrial *cargo* across the Pacific.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-produce
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
meaning: 名詞 農產品（不可數）
example: The supplier delivers fresh *produce* to local restaurants twice a week.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-software
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The IT department installed new *software* on every workstation.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-hardware
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The technician upgraded the *hardware* in the server room.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-scenery
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: Visitors praised the *scenery* surrounding the new resort.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-footwear
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The retailer expanded its *footwear* section this year.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-staff
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The entire *staff* attended the mandatory safety briefing.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-item
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: Each *item* on the invoice must match the shipping list.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-device
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The clinic purchased a new diagnostic *device* last month.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-product
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: The company launched a new *product* in the Asian market.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階#v-garment
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/13_不可數名詞陷阱進階
example: Every *garment* must pass quality inspection before shipment.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-following
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: *Following* the merger, several departments were consolidated.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-pending
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: The contract remains inactive, *pending* final approval.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-notwithstanding
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: *Notwithstanding* the budget cuts, the project proceeded on schedule.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-amid
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: Sales figures fluctuated *amid* ongoing supply shortages.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-barring

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: *Subsequent to* the recall, the company issued a public apology.

example: The vote will proceed *irrespective of* the objections raised.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: *Aside from* minor delays, the shipment arrived intact.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-with-the-exception-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: All budgets were cut, *with the exception of* R&D.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: *On top of* her regular duties, she now manages vendor contracts.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: The workshop was held *in conjunction with* the annual sales conference.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: The team worked overtime *for the sake of* meeting the deadline.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: The upgrade was offered *courtesy of* a partnership with the hotel chain.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: The survey was conducted *for the purpose of* improving customer service.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: The manager has no further comment *with respect to* the layoffs.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: Questions *in relation to* the merger should be directed to legal.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: Employees are reimbursed *per* the company's expense policy.

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語

chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: *In the event of* a system failure, contact IT immediately.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-in-case-of
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語
example: *In case of* an emergency, use the stairs, not the elevator.

id: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語#v-upon
chapterId: grammar/01_八大詞性與句型結構/14_介系詞片語作修飾語

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/01_基本時態與進行式#v-currently

example: The new design **resembles** the old logo.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/01_基本時態與進行式

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/02_完成式

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/02_完成式
example: **Prior to** the merger, the two firms had operated separately.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/02_完成式

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/02_完成式

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/02_完成式

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/03_被動語態

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/03_被動語態

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/03_被動語態

example: Prices **remained** stable last quarter.

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性#v-prior-to-that
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性
example: The two sides **have been negotiating** for weeks.

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性#v-expand
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/04_完成進行式與時態一致性

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/05_未來式與未來完成式進階

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/05_未來式與未來完成式進階

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/05_未來式與未來完成式進階

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/05_未來式與未來完成式進階

example: The marketing campaign will *kick off* next Monday.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/07_被動語態進階

example: The outgoing director **handed over** his responsibilities to the new hire.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/07_被動語態進階
example: The bank **lent** the startup a significant amount of capital.

example: The engineer will **demonstrate** the new feature to potential investors.

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/07_被動語態進階#v-entrust
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/07_被動語態進階

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-itinerary
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法

example: The airline is known for its *punctuality* on domestic routes.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識

example: Candidates who meet all the *criteria* will be shortlisted.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: These measures *safeguard* customer data in case of a breach.

example: The company will *reimburse* travel expenses provided receipts are submitted.

example: Employees may *opt out* of the program at any time.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: Management decided to **reorganize** the entire filing system.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The engineer **modified** the design after receiving customer feedback.

example: An **unidentified** caller reported the security breach.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The deal was reportedly financed by an **undisclosed** investor.

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-on-behalf-of

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-draft
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The contract was first **drafted** by the legal department.

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-wrap
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: All fragile items are **wrapped** with protective foam.

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-seal
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The envelope was **sealed** with wax before shipping.

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-assemble
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The furniture is **assembled** with a set of included tools.

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略

chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略

example: He **refused to** sign the agreement.

example: Please do not **hesitate to** contact us.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-strive
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The company **strives to** improve customer service.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-eager
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: She is **eager to** learn new skills.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-reluctant
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: He was **reluctant to** accept the offer.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-eligible
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: Employees are **eligible to** apply for the program.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-likely
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The price is **likely to** increase next month.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-in-order-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: We hired more staff **in order to** meet the deadline.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-so-as-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The manager arrived early **so as to** prepare the meeting room.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-be-supposed-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The report **is supposed to** be finished by Friday.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-be-scheduled-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The flight **is scheduled to** depart at noon.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-too...to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The box is **too heavy to** carry alone.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-avoid
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: We should **avoid** *making* the same mistake twice.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-suggest
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: The consultant **suggested** *restructuring* the department.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-consider
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: Please **consider** *joining* our new project team.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-postpone
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: They **postponed** *releasing* the quarterly report.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-recommend
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: I **recommend** *booking* the flight early.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-finish
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: She **finished** *drafting* the proposal this morning.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-mind
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: Would you **mind** *closing* the window?

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-look-forward-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: We **look forward to** *working* with you.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-be-used-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: He **is used to** *waking* up early.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-be-committed-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: The firm **is committed to** *reducing* waste.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-object-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: Several employees **object to** *changing* the schedule.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-be-worth
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: The seminar **is worth** *attending*.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-networking
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: **Networking** *is* essential for career growth.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-budgeting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: **Budgeting** *requires* careful planning.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-leading
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Leading** companies invest heavily in R&D.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-remaining
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: Please review the **remaining** issues before the deadline.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-rising
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: The **rising** cost of materials affects our margin.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-attached
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: Please see the **attached** file for details.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-enclosed
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: The **enclosed** brochure explains our services.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-qualified
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: We are looking for **qualified** candidates.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-detailed
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: A **detailed** report will be sent next week.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-regarding
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Regarding** your request, we need more information.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-given-(that)
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Given** the current budget, we must cut costs.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-provided-(that)
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: You may proceed **provided that** you have approval.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-considering
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Considering** the weather, the event may be delayed.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-bore
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: boring/bored | The lecture was so **boring** that many students fell asleep.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-tire
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: tiring/tired | After a **tiring** day, she went straight to bed.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-amaze
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: amazing/amazed | We were **amazed** *at* the results of the survey.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-frustrate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: frustrating/frustrated | The delay was extremely **frustrating** for the customers.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-motivate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: motivating/motivated | The bonus scheme is highly **motivating** for the sales team.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-overwhelm
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: overwhelming/overwhelmed | She felt **overwhelmed** *by* the amount of work.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-fascinate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: fascinating/fascinated | The museum exhibit was truly **fascinating**.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-interested-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: He **is interested in** *pursuing* a career in finance.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-satisfied-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: The client **is satisfied with** the final design.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-worried-about
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: Employees **are worried about** the upcoming layoffs.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-excited-about
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: The team **is excited about** the new product launch.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-claim
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: He **claims to have completed** the certification last year.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-seem
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: The data **seems to have been** miscalculated.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-regret
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: We **regret to inform** you of the delay.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-acknowledge
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: She **acknowledged having made** an error in the report.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-carry
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: He entered **with** a folder **carrying** important documents.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-verify
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: The invoice was approved **with** all figures **verified**.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-attach
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: She sent the email **with** a file **attached**.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-without-+-v-ing
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: You cannot enter the lab **without** *wearing* proper gear.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-be-worthy-of-+-v-ing/n
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: This achievement **is worthy of** *recognition*.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-being-p.p.
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: She disliked **being interrupted** during presentations.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-finalize
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The team needs one more day **to finalize** the budget proposal.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-notify
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is essential for the supervisor **to notify** all staff of the change.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-secure
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Our goal is **to secure** a long-term contract with the supplier.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-escalate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Any unresolved complaint should be **escalated to** the regional director.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-stagger
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Managers decided **to stagger** shifts in order to reduce congestion in the break room.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-outsource
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The firm plans **to outsource** its data entry tasks next quarter.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-streamline
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The new software was designed **to streamline** the approval process.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-withhold
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The finance office chose **to withhold** payment until the invoice was corrected.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-thoughtful
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It was **thoughtful of** the director *to acknowledge* every team member.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-considerate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It was **considerate of** her *to reschedule* the call for overseas clients.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-wise
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
meaning: 明智的（評價事或人皆可）
example: It would be **wise for** the firm *to diversify* its suppliers.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-prudent
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is **prudent for** managers *to review* every contract clause carefully.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-feasible
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is not **feasible for** the team *to finish* the audit by Friday.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-vital
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is **vital for** every employee *to understand* the safety procedures.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-inconsiderate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It was **inconsiderate of** him *to cancel* the meeting without notice.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-relieved
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The auditor was **relieved to** *find* no discrepancies in the accounts.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-astonished
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Investors were **astonished to** *hear* about the sudden merger.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-reluctant
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The supplier was **reluctant to** *lower* its prices further.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-content
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The client seemed **content to** *wait* for the revised proposal.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-anxious
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The intern was **anxious to** *make* a good impression during her first week.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-only-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The courier arrived early, **only to find** the office still closed.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-such...as-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The backlog was **such** a burden **as to** *delay* every downstream department.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-so-as-not-to-v

chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-approval
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The proposal is still awaiting final **approval** from the board.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-weather-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Weather permitting**, the site inspection will take place outdoors.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-time-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Time permitting**, we will also cover next quarter's targets.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-budget-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Budget permitting**, the firm plans to open a second branch office.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-schedule-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Schedule permitting**, the director will join the site visit in person.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-all-things-considered
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **All things considered**, the merger still appears financially sound.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-everything-considered
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Everything considered**, the vendor's proposal offers the best value.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-that-being-said
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The results were disappointing; **that being said**, the team learned valuable lessons.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-having-said-that
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Having said that**, management still supports the expansion plan.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-all-being-well
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **All being well**, the new branch will open by early next year.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-other-things-being-equal
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
meaning: 在其他條件相同的情況下
example: **Other things being equal**, the committee prefers the local supplier.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-generally-speaking
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Generally speaking**, quarterly reports are due within five business days.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-strictly-speaking
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Strictly speaking**, the contract does not cover overtime compensation.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-concerned-about
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Senior management **is concerned about** the *rising* cost of raw materials.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-dedicated-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The customer support team **is dedicated to** *resolving* complaints within 24 hours.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-devoted-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The foundation **is devoted to** improving working conditions in the factory.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-geared-toward
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: This training program **is geared toward** first-time managers.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-affiliated-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The consulting firm **is affiliated with** several major accounting networks.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-inclined-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The board **is inclined to** approve the expansion plan next quarter.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-accustomed-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Veteran staff **are accustomed to** working under tight deadlines.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-attached-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Please note that a revised invoice **is attached to** this email.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-tailored-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The proposal **was tailored to** the client's specific budget constraints.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-oriented-toward
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The new curriculum **is oriented toward** practical, hands-on skills.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-rooted-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The company's conservative pricing strategy **is rooted in** its early struggles during the recession.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-grounded-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Every recommendation in the report **is grounded in** verifiable market data.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-confined-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Access to the server room **is confined to** authorized IT personnel.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-restricted-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Parking on the ground floor **is restricted to** executives and visiting clients.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-limited-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The warranty **is limited to** manufacturing defects only.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-bound-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Without additional funding, the project **is bound to** fall behind schedule.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-tied-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Employee bonuses **are tied to** individual performance reviews.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-linked-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The delivery delay **was linked to** a shortage of shipping containers.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-associated-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: High turnover **is often associated with** poor management practices.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-involved-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Three departments **are directly involved in** the product launch.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-engaged-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The legal team **is currently engaged in** contract negotiations.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-absorbed-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The analyst **was so absorbed in** the spreadsheet that she missed the meeting reminder.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-preoccupied-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Executives **are preoccupied with** the upcoming merger announcement.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-convinced-of
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The investors **are convinced of** the product's long-term profitability.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-poised-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The startup **is poised to** enter the European market next year.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-positioned-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The firm **is well positioned to** benefit from the new trade agreement.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-slated-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The renovation **is slated to** begin in early September.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-destined-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Analysts believe the merger **is destined to** reshape the industry.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-plagued-by
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The rollout **was plagued by** technical glitches during its first week.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-steeped-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The firm's culture **is steeped in** tradition, which sometimes slows decision-making.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-allegedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The manager **allegedly** authorized the payment without approval.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-purportedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The document was **purportedly** signed by the former director.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-supposedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The missing shipment was **supposedly** lost in transit.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-rumored
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The company is **rumored** to have been in merger talks.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-documented
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The firm's growth is well **documented** to have started five years ago.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-inspect
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Every shipment must be scheduled to be **inspected** upon arrival.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-sanction
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The expansion plan is expected to be **sanctioned** by the board.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-refund
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Deposits are supposed to be **refunded** within two weeks of cancellation.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-relocate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The headquarters is scheduled to be **relocated** next spring.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-indemnify
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Affected customers are expected to be **indemnified** for the inconvenience.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-overhaul
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The outdated system needs to be **overhauled** before the merger.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-accomplish
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The team is proud to **have accomplished** the target ahead of schedule.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-outpace
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The department claims to **have outpaced** its quarterly quota.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-overlook
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The reviewer seems to **have overlooked** a key clause in the contract.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-underestimate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The manager admitted to **have underestimated** the project's complexity.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-withdraw
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The bidder is said to **have withdrawn** its offer at the last minute.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-said-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The vendor **is said to have** raised its prices last quarter.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-believed-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The delay **is believed to have been** caused by a software glitch.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-thought-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The proposal **is thought to have been** rejected by the board.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-poised-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The audit **is poised to be** completed by Friday.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-expected-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Staff **are expected to be** briefed before the site visit.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-liable-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Long-term employees **are liable to be** reimbursed for relocation costs.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-due-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The contract **is due to be** renewed next month.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-reported-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The factory **is reported to have** resumed operations.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-turn-out-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The invoice **turned out to have been** duplicated by mistake.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-negate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The new evidence did not *negate* the original agreement between the two firms.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-negation
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The clause's *negation* clearly excludes part-time staff from the bonus program.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-refrain
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Employees are asked to *refrain* from using personal devices during client meetings.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-abstain
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Two board members chose to *abstain* from voting on the merger proposal.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-decline
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The vendor politely *declined* to lower the price further.

example: The manager had to *restrain* himself from interrupting the presentation.

chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The steep fee is meant to *discourage* customers from canceling last minute.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-hesitant
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The board remained *hesitant* about not renewing the current supplier's contract.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-reluctantly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The director *reluctantly* agreed not to expand the department this year.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-thoroughly

example: The auditor *thoroughly* examined every invoice before signing off.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-diligently

example: The new analyst worked *diligently* to finish the forecast ahead of schedule.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-cautiously
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The CFO proceeded *cautiously* before approving the overseas investment.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-explicitly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The contract *explicitly* states that late deliveries will incur a penalty.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-deliberately
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The negotiator *deliberately* paused before presenting the counteroffer.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-inadvertently
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The clerk *inadvertently* omitted a required signature on the form.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-repeatedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The supplier *repeatedly* failed to meet the agreed delivery schedule.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-rigorously
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: All applicants are *rigorously* screened before receiving a job offer.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-consciously
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Managers were asked to *consciously* avoid favoring any single vendor.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-fully
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The team has not *fully* addressed the client's concerns yet.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-barely
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The department *barely* managed to meet the quarterly quota.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-strictly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Visitors are *strictly* prohibited from entering the server room unaccompanied.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-unintentionally
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The assistant *unintentionally* sent the confidential memo to the wrong list.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-outright
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The board *outright* rejected the proposal to relocate headquarters.

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-flatly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The supplier *flatly* refused not to raise prices next quarter.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-compel

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-oblige
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The contract **obliges** both parties to comply with the terms.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-permit
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The manager **permitted** staff to leave early on Friday.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-allow
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The policy **allows** employees to work remotely.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-enable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: This software **enables** users to track expenses easily.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-assist
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The consultant **assisted** the team in preparing the report.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-instruct
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-spot
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-glimpse
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: He **glimpsed** the manager leaving the building.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: I **overheard** them discussing the merger.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-perceive
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: Customers **perceived** the new packaging as more eco-friendly.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: The manager **sensed** tension among the team members.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: Nobody **noticed** the printer running out of paper.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-insist
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The client **insisted** that the order be delivered by Friday.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The union **demanded** that management raise wages.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The law **requires** that all drivers carry insurance.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The general **commanded** that the troops withdraw immediately.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The doctor **suggested** that she rest for a week.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: We **recommend** that applicants submit their forms early.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-propose
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: He **proposed** that the meeting be rescheduled.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The manager **urged** that the team finish the project on time.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-advise
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The consultant **advised** that the company invest in training.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: It is **imperative** that the issue be resolved today.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-advisable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: It is **advisable** that new staff attend orientation.
