chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The **requirement** that all staff wear badges is strictly enforced.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-recommendation
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: Her **recommendation** that the budget be increased was approved.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-require
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The job **requires** applicants to have three years of experience.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-expect
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: We **expect** the shipment to arrive by Monday.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-need
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The team **needs** everyone to cooperate on this project.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-allow
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The new software **allows** users to customize their dashboard.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-enable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: This grant **enables** small businesses to expand overseas.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-permit
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The manager **permitted** the intern to leave early.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-remind
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The system will **remind** users to update their passwords.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-warn
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The sign **warns** pedestrians to watch for traffic.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-advise
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The lawyer **advised** the client to sign the agreement.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-instruct
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The manual **instructs** technicians to check the voltage first.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-persuade
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The salesperson **persuaded** the customer to upgrade the plan.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-encourage
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: Managers are **encouraged** to give constructive feedback.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-invite
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The organizer **invited** attendees to ask questions.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-seem
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The offer *seemed* fair to everyone at the table.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-appear
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The figures *appear* accurate at first glance.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-look
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The renovated office *looks* impressive.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-sound
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The proposal *sounds* feasible.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-feel
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The workload *feels* unmanageable this quarter.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: (常見於產品描述情境，非本課重點但同類動詞)

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-become
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The process *became* simpler after automation.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-turn
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The tone of the meeting *turned* hostile.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-grow
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Client demands *grew* more specific over time.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-go
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The account *went* dormant after the client left.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-remain
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The budget *remained* unchanged despite inflation.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-stay
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Team performance *stayed* consistent all year.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-keep
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
meaning: 保持（常搭配現在分詞當補語）
example: The printer *keeps* jamming during rush hour.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-prove
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The strategy *proved* effective within a month.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-turn-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The candidate *turned out* highly qualified.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-reasonable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The refund policy is *reasonable*.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-convincing
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Her argument *seemed* convincing.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-plausible
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The excuse *sounded* plausible.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-stagnant
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Sales *remained* stagnant for two quarters.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-resilient
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The supply chain *proved* resilient during the shortage.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The new territory *appeared* lucrative to investors.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-obsolete
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-redundant
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Several positions *became* redundant after the merger.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-credible
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The witness *seemed* credible to the board.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-turbulent
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The industry *stayed* turbulent throughout the recession.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-viable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The expansion plan *proved* viable after the pilot test.

chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The strict policy *turned out* counterproductive.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-transparent

example: The manuscript still requires careful *editing*.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-redesign

example: The company website needs *redesigning* to look more modern.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-reword
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The vague clause in the agreement needs *rewording*.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-proofread
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The press release still needs *proofreading* before it goes out.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-correct
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: Several figures in the spreadsheet need *correcting*.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-upgrade
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The server needs *upgrading* to handle the extra traffic.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-patch
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The security flaw needs *patching* immediately.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-tweak
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The marketing plan just needs *tweaking* here and there.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-refine
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The forecasting model needs *refining* before it can be trusted.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-simplify
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The reimbursement procedure needs *simplifying*.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-mend
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The torn packaging on the delivered goods needs *mending*.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-repair
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The photocopier on the third floor needs *repairing*.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-update
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The employee directory needs *updating* every quarter.

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-touch-up
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The product photos need *touching up* before the catalog is printed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-assume
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: I **assume** that the shipment will arrive on time.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-confirm
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: Please **confirm** whether you will attend the seminar.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-determine
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: We need to **determine** what caused the delay.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-doubt
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: I **doubt** that the plan will work.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-essential
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: It is **essential** that all employees attend the training.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-evident
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: It is **evident** that sales have increased.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-inquire
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: She **inquired** whether the position was still open.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-mandatory
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: It is **mandatory** that staff wear badges.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-recommend
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: The manager **recommends** that we revise the budget.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-require
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: Policy **requires** that visitors sign in.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-suggestion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: My **suggestion** is that we postpone the launch.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-uncertain
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: I am **uncertain** whether the data is accurate.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-whatever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: Choose **whatever** option suits you best.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-in-charge-of
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: We don't know who is **in charge of** the project.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-as-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: There is disagreement **as to** whether the plan is feasible.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-whoever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: **Whoever** submits the form first will be considered.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-whatever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: You can use **whatever** tools you need.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-whichever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Choose **whichever** plan fits your budget.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-candidate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The candidate **whom** we interviewed impressed us.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-qualify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Employees **who qualify** may apply for the grant.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-eligible
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Staff **who are eligible** will receive benefits.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-supervisor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The supervisor **whose** team performed best was promoted.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-branch
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: This is the branch **where** the incident occurred.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-occasion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: There was an occasion **when** the system failed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-invest-in
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The fund **in which** we invested grew steadily.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-be-responsible-for
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The manager **who is responsible for** logistics resigned.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-credential
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Applicants **whose credentials** meet the standard will be shortlisted.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-comply-with
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Employees **who comply with** the policy avoid penalties.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-omit
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The clause **(which was) omitted** changed the contract's meaning.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-majority
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The firm has 50 clients, **most of whom** renewed their contracts.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-provided
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: You may leave early, **provided** you finish the report.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-once
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Once** approved, the budget cannot be changed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-whereas
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: Some prefer email, **whereas** others prefer calls.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-owing-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The flight was delayed **owing to** bad weather.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-due-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The meeting was postponed **due to** a scheduling conflict.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-in-spite-of
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **In spite of** the rain, sales remained strong.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-renovation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The store closed until **renovations** were complete.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-overtime
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: Staff worked **overtime** so that deadlines could be met.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-finalize
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Once** the design is **finalized**, production begins.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-postpone
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The launch was **postponed** because the samples were delayed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-in-the-event-that
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **In the event that** the server fails, contact IT immediately.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-as-long-as
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: You may work remotely **as long as** you attend meetings.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-come-into-effect
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The new policy will **come into effect** once it is approved.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-budget
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Although** the **budget** was tight, the project succeeded.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-compliant
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Provided that** the report is **compliant**, it will be accepted.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-unreal
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: This is an **unreal** condition contrary to fact.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-hypothetical
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: The scenario is purely **hypothetical**.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-insist
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: The client **insisted** that the deadline be extended.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-assumption
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: Our budget is based on an **assumption** that costs stay stable.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-contrary-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Contrary to** expectations, sales dropped.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-regret
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: I **regret** that I did not accept the offer.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-otherwise
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: Submit the form by Friday; **otherwise**, it will not be processed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-assistance
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Should** you need further **assistance**, contact support.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-inquiry
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Should** you have an **inquiry**, please call the hotline.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-compensate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: If the flight had been cancelled, the airline **would have compensated** passengers.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-presume
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: I **presume** that he would have agreed if asked.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-wish
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: I **wish** the meeting **were** shorter.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-exhausted
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: He looked **as if** he **were exhausted**.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-had-it-not-been-for
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Had it not been for** her help, we would have failed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-on-short-notice
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Were** we notified **on short notice**, we could still adapt.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-imply
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Her tone **implied** that the negotiation was not going well.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-assure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The technician **assured** the client that the system was secure.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-reveal
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The audit **revealed** that several accounts had been mismanaged.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-notification
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: We received a **notification** that the shipment had cleared customs.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-rumor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The **rumor** that the CEO would resign turned out to be untrue.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-allegation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The **allegation** that the firm overcharged clients is being reviewed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-belief
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There is a common **belief** that remote work increases productivity.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-possibility
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Management raised the **possibility** that the plant might relocate.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-likelihood
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The report noted the **likelihood** that demand would decline next quarter.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-assertion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The lawyer challenged the **assertion** that the contract was invalid.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-notion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Some staff still hold the **notion** that overtime pay is guaranteed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-conviction
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The director spoke with the **conviction** that the plan would succeed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-speculation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There has been **speculation** that the two firms will merge.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-hypothesis
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The team tested the **hypothesis** that faster shipping would raise sales.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-contention
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Her main **contention** is that the budget cuts were unnecessary.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-indication
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There was no **indication** that the vendor had missed the deadline.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-implication
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The email carried the **implication** that layoffs might follow.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-presumption
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The contract is based on the **presumption** that both parties act in good faith.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-testimony
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The witness gave **testimony** that the invoice had been altered.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-disclosure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The firm made a **disclosure** that its earnings would fall short of forecasts.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-revelation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The **revelation** that the data had been leaked alarmed customers.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-verdict
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The committee's **verdict** was that the proposal needed more research.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-confirmation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: We are still waiting for **confirmation** that the payment has gone through.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-admission
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The manager's **admission** that the report was inaccurate surprised the board.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-statement
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The bank issued a **statement** that all accounts remained secure.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-proof
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The auditor found **proof** that the figures had been falsified.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-concern
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There is growing **concern** that the supplier cannot meet the order.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-impression
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The client left with the **impression** that the deal was final.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-objection
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The board raised the **objection** that the timeline was too tight.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-oversee
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The director **oversees** the branch, which handles all regional accounts.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-procure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The department **procured** the equipment that the factory urgently needed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-expedite
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: We asked the supplier to **expedite** the shipment that had been delayed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-ratify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The shareholders **ratified** the merger, which had been under review for months.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-rectify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The accountant **rectified** the error that the audit had identified.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-uphold
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The board **upheld** the decision that the committee had made.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-delegate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The manager **delegated** the task to an assistant whom she trusted.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-encompass
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The policy **encompasses** all departments, which had previously followed separate rules.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-consolidate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The firm **consolidated** two branches, which had overlapping functions.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-spearhead
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Ms. Reyes **spearheaded** the initiative that transformed the department.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-tenure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Mr. Park, whose **tenure** ends in June, will be succeeded by a new director.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-incumbent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The **incumbent** manager, who has led the team for a decade, will retire.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-successor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The board has yet to announce the **successor** whom they have chosen.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-predecessor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The new CEO praised her **predecessor**, who built the company from scratch.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-mentor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Ms. Lin, who **mentors** new hires, was promoted last month.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-appraisal
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The performance **appraisal** that employees receive each year affects their bonuses.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-liaison
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Mr. Ito, who serves as the **liaison** between departments, resolved the conflict.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-onboard
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The HR team is working to **onboard** employees whose start dates fall this month.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-arbitration
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever method the two firms choose, **arbitration** remains the final option if negotiations fail.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-arbitrarily
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: The auditor may select whichever files she deems necessary, but she should not choose samples **arbitrarily**.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-authorize
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever is **authorized** to sign contracts must attend the closing ceremony in person.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-bidder
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever **bidder** submits the lowest quote will be awarded the logistics contract.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-circulate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever draft the legal team finalizes will be **circulated** to every department head.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-contingent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever plan is chosen, the launch date remains **contingent** on regulatory approval.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-disqualify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever entry violates the submission guidelines will be **disqualified** immediately.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-facilitate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever software the IT team installs should **facilitate** faster data sharing among branches.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-grievance
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever files a formal **grievance** will receive a written response within ten business days.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-impartial
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever candidate is selected, the interview panel must remain **impartial** throughout the process.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-incur
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever additional costs the delay may **incur** will be covered by the contractor.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-jurisdiction
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever handles the overseas contract must understand the local **jurisdiction** before proceeding.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-mediator
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever is chosen as the **mediator** must remain neutral throughout the dispute.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-negligence
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever caused the shipment error, the warehouse must investigate any sign of **negligence**.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-precedent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever ruling the tribunal issues will set a **precedent** for similar disputes in the industry.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-prevail
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever argument **prevails** in the meeting, the minutes must record every viewpoint discussed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-reallocate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: The board plans to **reallocate** whatever funds remain after the renovation project concludes.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-subordinate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever manages the project should assign clear duties to each **subordinate**.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-elapse
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Several weeks **elapsed** before the supplier responded to the complaint.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-lapse
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: There was a two-week **lapse** between the proposal and its approval.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-hitherto
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The department had **hitherto** relied on manual inventory checks.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-concurrently
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The two product lines were developed **concurrently** to save launch time.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-intermittent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: **Intermittent** delays in the supply chain frustrated the logistics team.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-timely
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: A **timely** response from the vendor prevented a production halt.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-overdue
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Several invoices remain **overdue** despite repeated reminders.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-expiration
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Staff must renew their access badges before **expiration**.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-retroactive
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The salary adjustment is **retroactive** to the start of the quarter.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-timeframe
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The consultant proposed a realistic **timeframe** for the migration project.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-protracted
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: A **protracted** dispute with the supplier delayed the shipment for months.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-milestone
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Reaching one million users was a major **milestone** for the platform.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-backlog
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
meaning: 積壓的工作、未處理事項
example: The support team is working through a large **backlog** of tickets.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-culminate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Months of negotiation **culminated** in a signed partnership agreement.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-granted-(that)
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **Granted that** the plan is risky, the potential return justifies it.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-on-condition-that
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The supplier agreed **on condition that** payment be made in advance.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-only-if
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **Only if** the budget is approved can the project begin.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-no-matter-how
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **No matter how** tight the schedule is, quality must not suffer.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-no-matter-what
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **No matter what** happens, the deadline stays the same.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-no-matter-who
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **No matter who** reviews the file, the conclusion will be identical.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-suppose-/-supposing-(that)
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **Supposing that** the deal falls through, we need a backup plan.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-even-so
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The audit was thorough; **even so**, minor errors were missed.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-whether-or-not
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The event will proceed **whether or not** it rains.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-for-fear-that
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The manager sent a reminder **for fear that** staff **might miss** the deadline.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-in-any-case
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **In any case**, the report must be submitted by Friday.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-at-all-costs
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The firm must protect client data **at all costs**.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-precaution
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: Employees are asked to take **precautions** against data leaks.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-stipulation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The contract's **stipulation** requires monthly progress reports.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-loophole
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: Lawyers identified a **loophole** in the agreement.

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-exemption
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
